name: Dispel Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
Your mastered magic item can dissolve the most powerful magic effects.

Prerequisite(s): Dispel Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Dispel Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. You can force the item to cast greater dispel magic by spending 2 daily uses of the feat (still only targeted dispels) or symbol of dispellingISG by spending 4 daily uses. If you also expend one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of the selected spell instead.
